sourceMetadata.prompt: Use case: text-localization. Edit the provided Russian storybook cover. Change ONLY the cream title lettering in its upper third to Spanish. Replace the top line with exact text "Señor PinPin" and the lower line with exact text "Hogar, dulce hogar". Preserve the large elegant cream storybook serif, the gentle curved title baseline, legibility and balanced spacing, and the small botanical flourishes. Fit both lines comfortably within their original title area. Keep EVERY illustrated element unchanged: all three hedgehogs, their identities, exact faces, sizes, poses and limbs, Mama's pitcher and water stream, tub, towel, room, camera framing, warm lighting, exposure, and every object. No new text, no other changes. Portrait 1024x1536 pixels full bleed.
sourceMetadata.review: Exact Spanish text is legible, including the tilde: Señor PinPin / Hogar, dulce hogar. Illustration visually matches the Russian master in composition, character count, faces, poses, tub, water stream and warm exposure; no obvious art drift. This is a visual assessment, not a pixel-identity guarantee. Same occluded-limb and exact-scale caveats as master. Selected preview pending user approval.
